propositions.text: The chart has signs that represent how others see marriage (the sentence's subject is the arudha signs — UL, UL2, A7)
propositions.evidence: The cited finding vote:marriage.arudha is family 'arudha', and the glossary defines arudha as 'the image point of a house... read for how its matters appear to the world'; A7 is 'read for partners as they appear' and the Upapada is 'read for marriage'

propositions.text: Those arudha signs are among the least supported areas for marriage in this reading (the arudha vote is against)
propositions.evidence: vote:marriage.arudha has direction 'against' (derivation 'the vote is against'), and in area_votes the arudha is the only one of the seven areas voting 'against' — the other six (house, lord, karaka, varga, kp, panchanga) vote 'for', so it is indeed the least supported

propositions.text: By contrast, the rest of the marriage reading is well supported (carried by 'however' and 'among the least supported')
propositions.evidence: Each cited finding's area_votes shows the same tally: 6 areas 'for' and 1 ('arudha') 'against'

propositions.text: The lack of support in these signs may reflect external perceptions or pressures around partnership
propositions.evidence: A hedged ('may reflect') interpretive reading; it is grounded in the arudha's own meaning in the glossary ('read for how its matters appear to the world' — i.e., external perception of the partnership). The disjunct 'pressures' on its own is not stated anywhere in the data, but under the 'may reflect' hedge the supported disjunct (external perceptions) carries the clause

propositions.text: These external perceptions/pressures don't align with the personal chart's promise of marriage
propositions.evidence: The cited findings together state exactly this mismatch: the arudha vote is 'against' (the external image) while the chart's own marriage areas vote 'for' — 6 of 7 areas, including karaka (Venus exalted) and varga, support marriage, so the arudha's 'against' does not align with the chart's promise

propositions.text: Venus is the main significator for marriage
propositions.evidence: the karaka finding lists Venus as its derivation planet for the marriage area, tops the derivation with the highest Shadbala ratio (1.33), its karaka verdict is "for", and the glossary entry for karaka names "Venus for partnership".
the karaka finding's Venus row gives dignity "exalted", and the glossary entry for exalted matches the ordinary meaning.
the karaka finding's Venus row gives sign "Pisces".

propositions.text: Venus sits in your house of fulfilment (the 11th, called the house of fulfilment)
propositions.evidence: the data's area_houses names this house only as "the 11th, a marriage house" (basis lagna, house 11); it does not list it as "the house of fulfilment" in those words, so the area-named label is unsupported even though Venus's placement in the 11th house from the lagna is stated.

propositions.text: The divisional chart for marriage (the D9/navamsa) supports it
propositions.evidence: the varga finding is for the marriage area (direction "for", varga verdict "for"), and its glossary defines the varga as a divisional chart and the navamsa as read for marriage.
